promises.quote: We use your email address to run your account and, only if you opt in, to send you news and offers.
promises.rationale: Mailchimp subscription is triggered only for opted-in users in syncNewsletter. Proof drives signup with opt-out then nightly job and asserts Mailchimp never receives the email.

promises.quote: We use your phone number only to protect your account with two-step verification.
promises.rationale: Phone must only leave the system via Twilio SMS. The nightly job also uploads phone numbers to Meta Custom Audiences — egress probe will catch this breach.

promises.quote: We never share your health information, including the reason for your appointment, with advertisers.
promises.rationale: sendScheduleEvent sends custom_data.reason to graph.facebook.com — this is the appointment reason (health info). The egress probe will detect it.

promises.quote: We never share your email address with advertisers.
promises.rationale: Meta Conversions API and Custom Audiences calls must not carry the raw email address. Mailchimp is a newsletter provider, not an advertiser.

promises.quote: We share personal data only with the service providers listed in section 7.
promises.rationale: All external HTTP calls must go only to the five listed providers. Drives the full user journey to exercise every egress path.

promises.quote: We never store or log your password in readable form.
promises.rationale: The database and log files must never contain the plaintext password. Proof scans residue after signup.

promises.quote: We never store your full card number; payments are handled by Stripe.
promises.rationale: After a payment the full card number must not appear in the SQLite db, search index or log files.

promises.quote: We do not use advertising or tracking cookies. We set a single cookie that keeps you signed in, and it is removed when you sign out.
promises.rationale: Only the tw_session cookie should be set across the full login/book/signout flow.

promises.quote: When you delete your account, we erase your personal data within 30 days.
promises.rationale: After account deletion + retention job run at day 31, canary data must not remain in any store.
